rows.label: qst500208_msg0001
rows.name:
Foorara has never been somewhere like
this before, mo.

rows.label: qst500208_msg0002
rows.name:
Such an empty backwater... No, such
a simple village, mooo.

rows.label: qst500208_msg0003
rows.name:
It's even more laid-back than Gula,
mo.

rows.label: qst500208_msg0004
rows.name:
The bustle of Invidia and Superbia
feels like a lie here, mo.

rows.label: qst500208_msg0005
rows.name:
The climate is nicer than Luxuria and
it's easy to live here, mo.

rows.label: qst500208_msg0006
rows.name:
This is such a nice place. I wonder
why more people don't come, mo.

rows.label: qst500208_msg0007
rows.name:
The Fortis Trade Guild travel guide
says a solo trip ends after you visit
eight countries or regions, mo.

rows.label: qst500208_msg0008
rows.name:
It's hard to leave, but Foorara will
return to Fortis Trade Guild now, mo.

rows.label: qst500208_msg0009
rows.name:
You've all helped me a lot, so please
come to Fortis Trade Guild to collect
a thank-you gift, mo!

rows.label: qst500208_msg0011
rows.name:
I see... Fortis Trade Guild is too
far away for you to come collect it,
mo.

rows.label: qst500208_msg0012
rows.name:
I wanted you all to see the Divine
Beast that looks like a Shark Gecko,
mo...

rows.label: qst500208_msg0013
rows.name:
Then I'll wait on Goldmund Flight Deck
in Avaritia Trading Company, mo. You
can make it there, mo?
